title: Stir-Fried Phyllo Rolls with Floral Sauce
description: A unique Japanese-inspired dessert combining crispy phyllo rolls with a sweet and floral sauce.
instructions: Cut the phyllo dough into 1-inch wide strips.
Brush the strips with stir-fry oil and fold them into triangles.
Place the phyllo triangles on a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the phyllo is baking, prepare the floral sauce by mixing syrup, Syrian cream, and water in a saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce thickens.
Remove the phyllo from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Dip the phyllo triangles into the floral sauce and coat evenly.
Serve the phyllo rolls warm or at room temperature.
Garnish with a drizzle of syrup and a sprinkle of sugar, if desired.
